stem: Lumen Health wants chargeback-grade database cost records for SQL analysis and proactive warning before monthly overspend. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use Cost Explorer dashboards as the only source for detailed line-item SQL reconciliation.
Publish Cost and Usage Report data for line-item chargeback analysis.
Purchase additional reserved capacity in each account to produce monthly cost alerts.
Use Performance Insights load charts as the monthly chargeback dataset.
Create AWS Budgets alerts on actual and forecasted spend thresholds.

rationale: Cost and Usage Report provides line-item billing data that fits SQL-based chargeback analysis, and AWS Budgets provides proactive threshold alerts. Cost Explorer is useful for trend analysis but not the most granular line-item SQL source by itself. Buying reserved capacity changes pricing exposure but does not create alerting controls. Performance Insights is performance telemetry, not billing line-item data.
